title: Creation: God's Good World
summary: God made the world good and made people to know Him and care for His creation. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.

read_it.prompt: Read Genesis 1:1-2:3 and look for how this passage teaches: God made the world good and made people to know Him and care for His creation.

tell_it: God created light, sky, land, plants, animals, and people. Everything God made showed His power and goodness.
understand_it: God made the world good and made people to know Him and care for His creation. This lesson keeps the main point simple: God is faithful, His Word is true, and His people can respond with faith and obedience.
age_5_7_explanation: Creation: God's Good World reminds us that God is good and we can trust Him. Creation matters.
age_8_11_explanation: Creation: God's Good World shows that following God is not only knowing the story. It means learning this truth: God made the world good and made people to know Him and care for His creation.
teen_explanation: Creation: God's Good World gives older students room to think about faith under pressure. The passage teaches that god made the world good and made people to know Him and care for His creation. It also asks how belief becomes action.
key_truths: God made the world good and made people to know Him and care for His creation.
God made the world and it belongs to Him.
God is faithful and His people can trust Him.
life_application: A kid can practice this when creation is needed: at school, with siblings, during disappointment, or when choosing between an easy wrong thing and a harder right thing.

quiz_questions.question: Who made the heavens and the earth?
quiz_questions.explanation: The passage points us back to this answer: God. It helps kids remember the main event and the truth it teaches.

quiz_questions.question: This lesson teaches that god made the world good and made people to know Him and care for His creation.
quiz_questions.explanation: That is the plain lesson focus for this passage, stated in kid-friendly language.

memory_verse.prompt: Remember Genesis 1:1 as a short anchor for this lesson.

discussion_questions: What happened in Creation: God's Good World?
What does this passage teach us about God or following Him?
Where could this lesson help you at home, school, church, or with friends?

activity.title: Creation Days Wheel
activity.instructions: Draw or act out the lesson scene, then name the one clear truth: God made the world good and made people to know Him and care for His creation.

prayer_prompt: Lord, help me learn from Creation: God's Good World. Teach me to trust You, listen to Your Word, and live this truth this week.
